review_text: Portal logged me out mid-way through filling my intake forms and none of my answers saved. Had to redo everything twenty minutes before my appointment.
Video call dropped twice during my consultation and the doctor had to finish the visit over a regular phone call instead.
Was billed the full out-of-network rate even though the provider is clearly listed as in-network on my insurance's own website. Three calls later, still unresolved.
Online scheduling let me book a same-week specialist appointment without calling anyone. Reminder texts were a nice touch too.
Requested a refill five days before running out and it still hasn't been approved. Pharmacy says they haven't received anything from the clinic.
Lab results showed up in the portal within hours, with plain-language explanations next to each value. Much less anxiety-inducing than waiting for a callback.
Appointment itself was fine but the waiting room screen said '5 minutes' for almost 40 minutes with no update or apology.
Called four times over two days trying to get someone to answer a billing question and was on hold over 20 minutes each time before giving up.
Received a surprise bill for a preventive screening that's supposed to be fully covered. Insurance says it was coded incorrectly by the clinic.
Confirmed appointment time in the app didn't match what the front desk had on file, and I was told I'd have to reschedule after driving 30 minutes.
Being able to message my doctor directly through the portal and get a same-day response for a non-urgent question has been genuinely great.
Refill process is fine once submitted, but there's no way to see the status without calling the pharmacy directly to check.
Video visit for a follow-up saved me a half-day off work. Doctor was attentive and the connection was crystal clear the whole time.
Check-in kiosk crashed and the front desk staff seemed unaware of how to restart it, so I ended up filling out paper forms anyway.
Statement listed three different charges for the same visit with no itemization. Billing department couldn't explain the discrepancy when I called.
Rescheduling an appointment through the app took under a minute. Only wish is that it showed same-day cancellation slots for urgent needs.
Can't see my child's records under the family account anymore after a recent portal update. Support said it's a 'known issue' with no timeline to fix.
Was charged a full telehealth copay for a visit that got disconnected before the doctor even joined. Never got the visit or a refund.
Front desk staff went out of their way to help me understand my referral paperwork and even called the specialist's office for me. Excellent service.
Auto-refill silently failed because my card on file expired, and I found out only when I was already out of medication over a weekend.
Payment plan setup was straightforward, though the monthly reminder emails go to a generic inbox that doesn't match what I signed up with.
Booked a 'new patient' slot online but showed up to find the office wasn't expecting a new patient and had to wait an extra hour to be worked in.
Virtual urgent care visit at 9pm on a Sunday was surprisingly smooth and got me a prescription sent to my pharmacy within the hour.
Portal shows an old insurance plan from two years ago no matter how many times I update it, causing claims to be submitted incorrectly.
Called about a confusing bill and the rep patiently walked through every line item with me instead of rushing me off the phone. Rare and appreciated.
Refill request went through fine this time but the portal notification came two days after the pharmacy had already filled it, which felt redundant.
Sent to collections for a bill I never received, despite having the same address and phone number on file for five years.
Specialist was able to review my uploaded photos during the video visit and adjust my treatment plan on the spot. Saved me an in-person trip entirely.
Waitlist feature for an earlier slot never notified me even after three earlier appointments opened up and were booked by other patients.
New medication list view clearly flags interactions with what I'm already taking. Small feature but genuinely reassuring before a new prescription.
Checked in on time but wasn't called back for 90 minutes with zero updates on the delay, not even an apology at checkout.
Cost estimate tool before my procedure was close to the final bill, off by less than $40. Much better than the surprise bills I've had elsewhere.
Requested a refill through the portal and it silently disappeared with no confirmation, no denial, nothing. Had to call to find out it was never processed.
Visit worked fine but the app doesn't let you upload a photo of a rash beforehand, so the doctor was diagnosing off my verbal description alone.
Got a same-day sick visit slot through the app in under two minutes on a Monday morning. This is exactly what online scheduling should feel like.
Two-factor authentication code never arrives by text, forcing me to call support every single time I need to check a lab result.
Front desk proactively told me about a lower-cost generic alternative before I even asked. Felt like they were actually looking out for my wallet.
Insurance pre-authorization for an MRI took three weeks with no visibility into status, and no one could tell me where in the process it was stuck.
Doctor seemed to be reading from a script and the whole visit felt rushed at under four minutes for a new concern I'd been dealing with for weeks.
Refill reminder notifications are genuinely useful now that they show up a full week ahead instead of the day medication runs out.
